details.user_story: As a user, I want to create a profile with my age group, handedness, and height so that I can receive personalized coaching feedback tailored to my demographic and physical attributes.
details.context:
**COMPLETED** - Implemented Supabase authentication with user profiles.

**What was implemented:**
- Supabase Auth integration for secure password-based authentication
- JWT token-based API authentication
- User profile fields: age_group (10u/12u/14u/16u/18u/college/adult), handedness (left/right/switch), height_cm
- Auto-creation of users in local database on first login
- Profile endpoints: GET /api/profile, PATCH /api/profile
- Updated video upload to use authentication
- Updated swings endpoint to use authentication (GET /api/swings)
- Mobile app integration with Supabase client
- Session persistence with auto-refresh

**Breaking Changes:**
- Old email-only authentication replaced with password-based auth
- Existing users need to re-register through Supabase
- Swings endpoint changed from /api/users/{user_id}/swings to /api/swings (authenticated)

**Environment Variables Added:**
- Backend: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
- Mobile: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

**Files Modified:**
- Backend: 7 files (supabase_client.py, auth_middleware.py, models.py, main.py, requirements.txt, .env.example, migration)
- Mobile: 8 files (AuthService.js, UserContext.js, LoginScreen.js, SignupScreen.js, UploadService.js, SwingService.js, ProfileScreen.js, config files)

**Status:** ✅ Complete and deployed to production

details.technical_details:
**Backend Architecture:**
- Supabase client singleton for JWT verification
- FastAPI dependency injection for authentication (get_current_user, get_optional_user)
- User model extended with supabase_id (UUID), age_group (enum), handedness (enum), height_cm (integer)
- Alembic migration: 87958b8ee2f6_add_user_profile_fields

**Mobile Architecture:**
- Supabase client configured with anon key
- AuthService rewritten for Supabase (signup, login, logout, fetchProfile, updateProfile)
- UserContext listens to Supabase auth state changes
- JWT tokens included in Authorization headers for API calls

**Security:**
- Service role key (backend only) for JWT verification
- Anon key (mobile app) for client-side auth
- Row-level security ready for future implementation

**Database Schema:**
- users.supabase_id: VARCHAR(255), unique, indexed
- users.age_group: ENUM agegroup
- users.handedness: ENUM handedness
- users.height_cm: INTEGER

**API Changes:**
- NEW: GET /api/profile (requires auth)
- NEW: PATCH /api/profile (requires auth)
- NEW: GET /api/swings (requires auth, replaces /api/users/{user_id}/swings)
- UPDATED: POST /api/videos/upload (now uses optional auth)
- REMOVED: POST /api/users (replaced by Supabase signup)
- REMOVED: GET /api/auth/login (replaced by Supabase login)
details.edge_cases:
**Handled:**
- Enum case mismatch (database lowercase vs Python uppercase) - fixed by removing default value
- User creation failure when email already exists - handled with proper error messages
- Missing alembic_version table - gracefully handled
- Email confirmation required - documented workaround (disable in Supabase settings)
- Existing users with NULL supabase_id - documented migration path

**Known Limitations:**
- Existing users must re-register (breaking change)
- Email confirmation must be disabled for MVP (or users must confirm via email)
- Profile fields are optional (can be NULL)
- No profile UI for editing fields yet (endpoint exists, UI pending)
